items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: He is the one that played with Count Basie... I just played locally.

ctx.x: There was three of us. My sister died some years ago. There was three of us, my brother — my brother is a big shot — not me, I’m the little guy. He is the one that played with Count Basie and Lionel Hampton and Sarah Vaughan and all the big people. I just played locally. I’m the little guy.
Yeah but you had your role.
